interpretation: RINT0x2c=CMD_DONE+DATA_OVER+DRR and no reported card CRC/timeout error. Command/receive path reached completion; host timeout was software waiting for DMA conditions.
DRR is a sticky raw-interrupt event, not current FIFO occupancy. Current FIFO state was not recorded.
Both coherent DMA addresses are below4GiB and satisfy documented word-address encoding/alignment. This does not prove engine fetched the descriptor.
The driver requires IDST direction completion while IDIE is0; Tina/upstream enable IDIE RX for reads. Event gating is the most direct first single-variable hypothesis.

SMHC3 manual explicitly says NIS is affected only by unmasked bits, but does not clearly say raw RX/TX status requires IDIE. IDIE causality is not proven until before-reset OWN/FIFO snapshots or experiment results.
